name: The Pannonian armed forces: order of battle
status: Skeleton, 22 October 2026 (roadmap: the nation on the map, N0): the services and every unit the theatre and the chain of command already hold. N2 fills in the rest from the briefing (docs/campaign/10_BRIEFING_FORCES_AND_NATION.md §4-9).
source: game value: the briefing's command structure and decisions (two services beside the Ground Forces; five Osa batteries, flak11; two motor rifle divisions of three regiments and a tank brigade with the Kub); posts from data/command/chain_pannonia.json; objects from data/air_war/theatre_pannonia.json; the Osa battery's equipment from voenizdat_osa_1991 p226; establishments are estimates unless a basis is named
notes: Equipment types are basic model ids (data/scenery/basic_models.json) where a model exists; the others get theirs in N3. Every military theatre object belongs to exactly one unit, and every chain post to at most one (tests/test_country_map.cpp).

services.name: Ministry of National Defence and the General Staff
The National Air Defence
services.notes: Holds the fighters, the S-75M2 and S-125M1 units, the KS-30s and the radio-technical troops (decision 7).

units.name: Ministry of National Defence and the General Staff
7th Motor Rifle Division
units.notes: Its three regiments and their AA batteries (one of them the southern group's Strela platoon, to become Strela-1s: decision 3) come in N2. The garrison commandant of Kesmark answers to the division through its chief of staff.

units.name: 15th SAM Regiment (Osa-AK)
units.notes: Five batteries, a headquarters battery with the PU-12M and the radars, a technical battery (flak11; decision 4).

units.name: 15th SAM Regiment: technical battery
units.notes: At the Horka siding. Its theatre object comes with the rebuild and supply objects (13.2, N2).

units.name: Battery 21

personnel.basis: the PU-12M's battery commander and four numbers (valka_pu12, ru_pu12_text), four launcher crews of five (roadmap 6.1), the maintenance crew of four (voenizdat_osa_1991 p189); the MANPADS and supply sections and the split by rank are estimates

units.notes: Also the 9V210M3 maintenance and ZIP-2 vehicles and three MANPADS launchers (voenizdat_osa_1991 p226): their types get models in N3.

units.name: Battery 23
units.notes: Its theatre object comes in N2.

units.name: Battery 24
units.notes: Its theatre object comes in N2.

units.name: Battery 25
units.notes: Its theatre object comes in N2.

units.name: 9th Motor Rifle Division
units.notes: The second division (decision 6; its number is a proposal). Its S-60 regiment and its regiments' AA batteries (the western group's Strela platoon among them) come in N2.

units.name: The tank brigade
units.notes: The army's reserve; the Kub battery is its air defence (decision 6).

units.name: The south-western brigade
units.notes: The front-line belt facing the Noric Republic (docs/air_war/09_BALANCE.md finding 3).

units.name: 3rd Fighter Regiment (MiG-21, MiG-23ML)
units.notes: And a squadron of about 12 MiG-23MLs (decision 2): its model comes in N3.

units.name: S-75 fire unit at Novo Varosd
The Air Force
units.notes: Fighter-bombers, reconnaissance, training, transport, helicopters: N2.

units.name: The rear services
units.notes: Central and regional depots and the military transport offices. The fuel reserve and the railway troops come in N2.
